title: Modelling suicide ideation from beep to beep: Application of network analysis to ecological momentary assessment data
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Sample only consists of psychiatric inpatients with major depression; - Limited EMA design (10 beeps/day, 30-120 min intervals) may miss important dynamics; - Self-report data only, no objective measures; - Underpowered to detect subtle dynamic relations; - Findings may not generalize to outpatient or non-clinical populations
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. Code and data availability are not clearly declared in the main text, though supplementary materials or repositories may exist. The authors mention using mlVAR and qgraph packages in R, but do not specify versions or whether code is publicly available.
